TC-18/S08.title: Custom template: the type drives the family exactly like the stock template; 'Procedure / other' gets no billing
TC-18/S08.detail: Local 43c38a4f, model never called: billing on this build is a server job enqueued by the note save, so every local job ran on a note with no sentence (real job, family from the frozen template, no model call) or the chart was seeded with a suggestion the app's own code built from a scripted model answer (no job); proof: no billing ai_disclosure audit row with provider_ms, tripwire clean. Templates made in Settings -> New with a type: Hospital Progress note -> hospital-subsequent, H&P -> hospital-initial, Discharge -> hospital-discharge (time prompt); Nursing Home SNF Progress -> snf-subsequent, SNF Discharge -> snf-discharge (time prompt); the frozen type equals the stock template's (24/24 with S07). Procedure / other (both contexts): the generated note is shown, no billing card, no code, no 'Analyzing note', no error card, no billing job (Q9: no card at all). Over the API all 8 billed types make one job each and SNF Consult -> snf-initial (21/21). Recorded, todo (U8 belongs to TFA-92599): the type list is per context — Hospital H&P / Progress note / Consult / Discharge / Procedure / other, Nursing Home SNF Admission / SNF Progress / SNF Consult / SNF Discharge / Procedure / other, no Handoff or Clinic (Q11: TC-21 S13 expects all 8 in Hospital).
